The commit was rejected due to "hard.control-character" (probably the escaped quotes in the message? No... maybe the `\"` sequences) and "role.contributor.history".

Hmm, "role.contributor.history" — the contributor role may be restricted from rewriting history (amend). A regular commit should be fine... but the rejection cites both rules. Maybe the `\"` escapes triggered "hard.control-character" due to the backslashes, and the commit being part of a chained history op.

Let me try a simpler commit message without quotes/backslashes and without the multi-paragraph body.
